jess_cs: Heads-up — ACME (customer_jane) opened a high-severity ticket after the quantization profile rollout this morning. They report a visible answer-shift on our chat endpoint plus intermittent 502/401 spikes.
omer_ml: can you paste the customer's exact examples and timestamps? which model + profile did we roll to prod? :thinking_face:
jess_cs: They were on open-llama-70b @ int8-compact profile that went live at 11:28 PST (deploy-bot shows canary -> prod done). Customer says behavior changed at ~11:33 and started seeing 502s around same time. Here's their minimal repro.
customer_jane: repro (simplified):
```
prompt: "Summarize the following technical design: ... (sensitive redacted)"
params: { temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 400 }
expected: concise technical summary with bullet points
observed (after rollout): long speculation + invented API details not present in prompt
```
jess_cs: They attached two model outputs (pre-rollout vs post-rollout). The post-rollout contains confidently wrong details.
omar_ml: thanks. can you also attach request_ids / route and any correlation ids? 502 + 401 makes me think there was a spike that hit a fallback path or token validation race.
jess_cs: request_ids: rq_8f3b... (several). Route: /v1/chat/completions model=open-llama-70b-int8-compact. Also saw spikes in token validation logs: "auth: invalid token" for a handful of requests that should be valid.
sasha_runtime: I pulled infra traces for those request_ids. Two things stand out:
- around deploy window we had a short burst of worker restarts on the int8 pool (OOM mitigations), causing a transient 502 flood
- KV-cache warmup looks fine, but there is a mismatch in model quant params between the serving binary and the deployed quant profile metadata (one node reporting profile v3, others v2)
lee_oncall: that mismatch could explain answer drift if some nodes used different scale/zero points. also the auth errors might be related to a timing issue during pool rotation (tokens signed with old key for a few seconds).
omar_ml: can you dump the quant profile diff? even a small change in scale matrices can shift logits. jess_cs can you ask customer to attach the failing request payload + seed (if sent)?
jess_cs: shared with them, they'll send seed + request JSON. Meanwhile, here's the profile diff from release artifacts:
```
quant-profile: int8-compact
- use_per_channel: false
- clip_value: 6.0
+ use_per_channel: true
+ clip_value: 5.2
+ rounding: stochastic
```
omar_ml: hmm enabling per-channel with stochastic rounding + lower clip could change token probabilities noticeably. that's a plausible root cause for quality shift.
sasha_runtime: follow-ups:
1) mark the int8-compact pool as draining and switch traffic to int8-stable (older profile) via routing policy (canary rollback of profile)
2) rollback the metadata so all nodes report same profile
3) investigate why the deploy produced mixed profiles (artifact mismatch)
lee_oncall: I'll run the rollback now and keep on-call looped. deploying traffic policy change.
deploy-bot: canary rollback initiated by lee_oncall for profile int8-compact -> int8-stable at 1827002200.
lee_oncall: rolling back routing. monitoring latency, error-rate, and sample outputs.
jess_cs: ACME confirmed they saw immediate improvement after ~2 minutes — answer tone matches pre-rollout baseline and 502/401 spikes subsided. They provided the post-rollback outputs and they look aligned.
omar_ml: good. next steps:
- run a deterministic re-run of the failing prompts across both profiles (int8-stable vs int8-compact) with same seed to quantify delta (log-perplexity and token-delta)
- add a canary validation that runs a small corpus of customer-critical prompts when a quant profile changes, check NLL and semantic diffs before flipping traffic
- enforce artifact immutability so profile metadata can't drift between nodes
sasha_runtime: opened infra ticket to audit release artifacts and the deploy graph that caused mixed metadata. assigning to eng-runtime.
jess_cs: customer asked whether this will appear on invoice / billing — they saw slightly higher token counts due to repeats in post-rollout outputs. it's probably transient but please confirm.\nomar_ml: billing impact is likely tiny; but if the model generated longer outputs due to hallucinations it could increase tokens. CS pls create follow-up with billing with exact request_ids and timestamps.
jess_cs: will do. tagging the ticket P1 and will keep customer_jane posted. thanks everyone.
lee_oncall: leaving note: measured token-delta avg +18 tokens per affected request (from our quick sample). adding to postmortem.
omar_ml: I'll prepare a short blameless postmortem and plan for an automated regression test for quant changes.
jess_cs: great — I'll update the customer and close after we confirm infra fix and perf tests. :thumbsup:
